title: Metroid II: Return of Samus
shortDescription: Metroid II: Return of Samus helps define a Game Boy family action path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Brings a source-aware action entry to the Game Boy family browsing route.
Uses a factual reference path instead of an aggregate score or review.
